<!--
Playful homepage hero collage. Originally prototyped as a standalone HTML
mockup (irw_homepage_hero_playful_v2.html) with cards scattered at random
tilts; restructured 2026-07-27 per reviewer feedback (David Lang, Michael
Leon Chrzan) into a hierarchy with TABLES/PEOPLE circles above an ITEMS
circle ringed by item-type cards.

Restructured again 2026-07-29 to v3 (irw-hero-v3.html, workshopped in a
separate Claude Artifacts conversation): each cluster (Tables, People,
Items, Responses) is now drawn as its own labeled "zone box" with a tag
cloud of illustrative attributes underneath its stamp, and a new dedicated
Responses zone was added alongside Tables/People/Items. The item-type ring
around ITEMS was trimmed from 5 cards to 3 (Choose an answer / Strongly
agree? / How confident?) -- true/false and checkbox cards were dropped in
this pass. Tag-cloud labels (tableDomains, peopleTraits, responseAttributes)
are illustrative only, same status as the item-type examples: IRW has no
domain/trait taxonomy to source them from.

Stamp numbers and badge counts come from data/hero_stats.json via
CONFIG, built below from ojs_define()'d hero_stats -- nothing in the CSS or
DOM-building code needs to change when the underlying figures update.

Two responsive breakpoints are load-bearing and intentionally separate:
760px switches the 4 zone boxes from a stacked column to the absolute-
positioned box layout, and 960px (a second, later breakpoint) switches the
ITEMS zone's inner content from stacked to the absolute-positioned ring
layout and turns on the connector lines. The ring needs more horizontal
room than the box-split alone provides, which is why this isn't collapsed
into a single breakpoint.

All CSS selectors are scoped under `.irw-hero` and all element IDs are
prefixed `irw-hero-` since this is included inside the main site, not
rendered standalone.
-->

```{r}
#| label: load-hero-stats
#| include: false

library(jsonlite)

# Emergency fallback only: used if data/hero_stats.json is missing or fails
# to parse at build time (e.g. accidental deletion, bad merge). This keeps
# `quarto render` from failing rather than being a source of truth -- it is
# NOT refreshed automatically by metadata/00_hero_totals.R or
# metadata/00_hero_category_breakdown.R (those write the checked-in JSON
# file), so it will drift stale over time. Update by hand only if the
# checked-in JSON itself is broken and a rebuild is needed before a fix
# lands.
hero_stats_fallback <- list(
  generated_at = "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  totals = list(n_tables = 1300, n_responses = 27000000000, n_participants = 65000000, n_items = 730000),
  category_breakdown = list(
    list(n_categories = 2,    n_items = 148589, n_responses = 2112679586),
    list(n_categories = 3,    n_items = 11974,  n_responses = 28686057),
    list(n_categories = 4,    n_items = 31583,  n_responses = 54052143),
    list(n_categories = 5,    n_items = 86988,  n_responses = 172105890),
    list(n_categories = 6,    n_items = 18967,  n_responses = 6905164),
    list(n_categories = "7+", n_items = 103551, n_responses = 127337448)
  )
)

hero_stats_path <- "data/hero_stats.json"

hero_stats <- tryCatch({
  parsed <- fromJSON(hero_stats_path, simplifyVector = FALSE)
  required_totals <- c("n_tables", "n_responses", "n_participants", "n_items")
  valid <- is.list(parsed$totals) && all(required_totals %in% names(parsed$totals)) &&
    is.list(parsed$category_breakdown)
  if (!valid) stop("hero_stats.json missing required fields")
  parsed
}, error = function(e) {
  warning("components/_hero_playful.qmd: ", hero_stats_path,
          " missing or malformed (", conditionMessage(e),
          ") -- rendering hero with fallback values.")
  hero_stats_fallback
})

ojs_define(hero_stats = hero_stats)
```

/* ---------- >=760px: box-split layout ----------
   Load-bearing breakpoint #1 of 2 -- switches the 4 zone boxes from a
   stacked column to the absolute-positioned side-by-side arrangement.
   Kept separate from the 960px breakpoint below (see file header comment):
   the item-type ring needs more horizontal room than this alone provides. */
@media (min-width:760px){
  .irw-hero .collage{ display:block; min-height:900px; }
  .irw-hero .zone-box{ position:absolute; max-width:none; }
  .irw-hero #irw-hero-zone-tables{ left:0; top:0; width:calc(50% - 12px); }
  .irw-hero #irw-hero-zone-people{ right:0; top:0; width:calc(50% - 12px); }

  .irw-hero #irw-hero-zone-responses{ right:0; top:340px; width:calc(27% - 10px); max-width:none; }
}

/* ---------- >=960px: item-type ring layout ----------
   Load-bearing breakpoint #2 of 2 -- switches the ITEMS zone's inner
   content from stacked to the absolute-positioned ring (stamp centered,
   3 cards positioned around it) and turns on the connector-line SVG.
   Gated separately from 760px above because the ring needs more room than
   the box-split provides on its own; collapsing these into one breakpoint
   will overlap the 3 cards at intermediate widths. */
@media (min-width:960px){
  .irw-hero .collage{ min-height:760px; }
  .irw-hero #irw-hero-items-inner{ position:relative; display:block; height:340px; }
  .irw-hero #irw-hero-items-inner .stamp,

  .irw-hero #irw-hero-card-slider{ right:10%; top:70px; width:190px; }

  .irw-hero .connectors{ display:block; position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; pointer-events:none; }
}
</style>`

```{ojs}
//| label: hero-formatters
//| echo: false

// Abbreviated K/M/B formatter for stamp numbers and ×N badges: 3 significant
// figures, trailing ".0" dropped (e.g. 172105890 -> "172M", 6905164 -> "6.9M").
fmtAbbrev = (n) => {
  if (n == null || isNaN(n)) return "";
  const units = [[1e9, "B"], [1e6, "M"], [1e3, "K"]];
  for (const [threshold, suffix] of units) {
    if (Math.abs(n) >= threshold) {
      const scaled = n / threshold;
      const digits = Math.abs(scaled) >= 100 ? 0 : 1;
      return scaled.toFixed(digits).replace(/\.0$/, "") + suffix;
    }
  }
  return Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-US");
}

// Thousands-grouped integer, used for the "tables" stamp (shown in full,
// not abbreviated, per the v2 prototype).
fmtInt = (n) => (n == null || isNaN(n)) ? "" : Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-US");

// Spelled-out magnitude for the tagline prose ("3.2 billion answers").
fmtWords = (n) => {
  if (n == null || isNaN(n)) return "";
  if (Math.abs(n) >= 1e9) return (Math.round(n / 1e8) / 10) + " billion";
  if (Math.abs(n) >= 1e6) return (Math.round(n / 1e5) / 10) + " million";
  if (Math.abs(n) >= 1e3) return (Math.round(n / 1e2) / 10) + " thousand";
  return fmtInt(n);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| label: hero-config
//| echo: false

// Fixed badge -> response-category mapping (decision: explicit, not
// inferred at render time). Only 3 of the 6 category buckets are surfaced
// here since the v3 ring only has 3 item-type cards (multiple_choice,
// likert, and confidence/slider -- true_false and checkbox were dropped
// in the v3 restructure).
heroCategoryMap = ({
  choice: 4,
  likert: 5,
  slider: "7+"
})

heroCategoryLookup = new Map(
  (hero_stats.category_breakdown || []).map(d => [String(d.n_categories), d])
)

// Hide a card's badge rather than render "×0" / "×NA" if its bucket is
// missing or zero in the current data refresh.
heroBadge = (key) => {
  const cat = heroCategoryMap[key];
  if (cat === undefined) return null;
  const row = heroCategoryLookup.get(String(cat));
  if (!row || !row.n_responses) return null;
  return "×" + fmtAbbrev(row.n_responses);
}

// Single place real numbers/tags feed into the collage -- everything below
// this cell builds DOM from CONFIG and shouldn't need to change when the
// underlying figures update. tableDomains/peopleTraits/responseAttributes
// are illustrative only (see file header comment) and stay hand-written.
CONFIG = ({
  tables: fmtInt(hero_stats.totals.n_tables),
  people: fmtAbbrev(hero_stats.totals.n_participants),
  items: fmtAbbrev(hero_stats.totals.n_items),
  responses: fmtWords(hero_stats.totals.n_responses),
  responsesAbbrev: fmtAbbrev(hero_stats.totals.n_responses),
  badges: {
    choice: heroBadge('choice'),
    likert: heroBadge('likert'),
    slider: heroBadge('slider')
  },
  tableDomains: ['Education','Psychology','Health','Cognition','Personality','Political Science','Consumer Behavior','Linguistics'],
  peopleTraits: ['Gender','Age','Ability','Race / Ethnicity','Language','Socioeconomic Status','Education Level','Treatment Status'],
  responseAttributes: ['Ordinal Responses','Response Time','Date','Item Text']
})

PALETTE = ['var(--blue)','var(--purple)','var(--green)','var(--pink)','var(--orange)','var(--yellow)']
```

```{ojs}
//| label: hero-collage
//| echo: false

heroRoot = {
  const intervals = [];
  const track = (id) => { intervals.push(id); return id; };

  const root = document.createElement('div');
  root.className = 'irw-hero';
  root.innerHTML = `
    <div class="page">
      <div class="header">
        <div class="pill-badge">ITEM RESPONSE WAREHOUSE</div>
        <h1 class="headline">
          Every question ever answered<sup>*</sup>, in
          <span class="highlight">one place
            <svg viewBox="0 0 200 20" preserveAspectRatio="none">
              <path d="M2,14 C30,4 50,18 75,10 C100,2 120,16 145,8 C165,2 180,14 198,8"
                    fill="none" stroke="var(--yellow)" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
            </svg>
          </span>
        </h1>
        <p class="footnote">*Well, nearly every question!</p>
        <p class="tagline"><strong>${CONFIG.responses}</strong> responses. True/false, five-star, multiple choice, Likert — all reshaped into one format.</p>
        <a class="cta" href="data.html">Explore the warehouse →</a>
      </div>

      <div class="collage" id="irw-hero-collage">

        <div class="zone-box" id="irw-hero-zone-tables">
          <div class="box-tab">Tables</div>
          <div class="zone-inner">
            <div class="stamp bob" style="animation-delay:0s;">
              <div class="stamp-number">${CONFIG.tables}+</div>
              <div class="stamp-label">TABLES</div>
            </div>
            <div class="tag-cloud" id="irw-hero-table-domains"></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="zone-box" id="irw-hero-zone-people">
          <div class="box-tab">People</div>
          <div class="zone-inner">
            <div class="stamp bob" style="animation-delay:.5s;">
              <div class="stamp-number">${CONFIG.people}</div>
              <div class="stamp-label">PEOPLE</div>
            </div>
            <div class="tag-cloud" id="irw-hero-people-traits"></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="zone-box" id="irw-hero-zone-items">
          <div class="box-tab">Items</div>
          <svg class="connectors" id="irw-hero-connectors"></svg>
          <div class="zone-inner" id="irw-hero-items-inner">
            <div class="stamp bob" id="irw-hero-stamp-items" style="animation-delay:.3s;">
              <div class="stamp-number">${CONFIG.items}+</div>
              <div class="stamp-label">ITEMS</div>
            </div>
            <div class="card bob" id="irw-hero-card-choice" style="animation-delay:.15s;"></div>
            <div class="card bob" id="irw-hero-card-likert" style="animation-delay:0s;"></div>
            <div class="card bob" id="irw-hero-card-slider" style="animation-delay:.45s;"></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="zone-box" id="irw-hero-zone-responses">
          <div class="box-tab">Responses</div>
          <div class="zone-inner">
            <div class="stamp bob" style="animation-delay:.2s;">
              <div class="stamp-number">${CONFIG.responsesAbbrev}</div>
              <div class="stamp-label">RESPONSES</div>
            </div>
            <div class="tag-cloud" id="irw-hero-response-attributes"></div>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>

      <p class="caption">All numbers shown are approximate and metadata is available in limited cases.</p>
    </div>
  `;

  const $ = (sel) => root.querySelector(sel);

  function buildTagCloud(id, labels) {
    const el = $(id);
    el.innerHTML = labels.map((label, i) =>
      `<span class="bubble"><span class="dot" style="background:${PALETTE[i % PALETTE.length]};"></span>${label}</span>`
    ).join('');
  }
  buildTagCloud('#irw-hero-table-domains', CONFIG.tableDomains);
  buildTagCloud('#irw-hero-people-traits', CONFIG.peopleTraits);
  buildTagCloud('#irw-hero-response-attributes', CONFIG.responseAttributes);

  // Item-type card content.
  const cardDefs = [
    { id:'#irw-hero-card-choice', badgeKey:'choice', dot:'var(--purple)', label:'Choose an answer',
      body:`<div class="mini-single" data-single-group><div class="radio active">A</div><div class="radio">B</div><div class="radio">C</div><div class="radio">D</div></div>` },
    { id:'#irw-hero-card-likert', badgeKey:'likert', dot:'var(--pink)',   label:'Strongly agree?',
      body:`<div class="mini-likert" data-likert-group><span class="likert-edge">DIS</span><div class="likert-dot"></div><div class="likert-dot"></div><div class="likert-dot"></div><div class="likert-dot"></div><div class="likert-dot"></div><span class="likert-edge">AGR</span></div>` },
    { id:'#irw-hero-card-slider', badgeKey:'slider', dot:'var(--orange)', label:'How confident?',
      body:`<div class="mini-slider"><div class="slider-track"><div class="slider-knob"></div></div><div class="slider-nums"><span>0</span><span>100</span></div></div>` }
  ];
  cardDefs.forEach(def => {
    const el = $(def.id);
    const badge = CONFIG.badges[def.badgeKey];
    el.innerHTML = `${badge ? `<div class="badge">${badge}</div>` : ''}
      <div class="card-label"><span class="dot" style="background:${def.dot};"></span>${def.label}</div>
      ${def.body}`;
  });

  // Mini-demo animations (slider knob is pure CSS animation, see @keyframes
  // irwHeroSlideKnob above).
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-single-group]').forEach(group => {
    const radios = group.querySelectorAll('.radio');
    let idx = 0;
    const render = () => radios.forEach((r, i) => r.classList.toggle('active', i === idx));
    render();
    track(setInterval(() => { idx = (idx + 1) % radios.length; render(); }, 900));
  });

  root.querySelectorAll('[data-likert-group]').forEach(group => {
    const dots = group.querySelectorAll('.likert-dot');
    let idx = 0, dir = 1;
    const render = () => dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx));
    render();
    track(setInterval(() => {
      idx += dir;
      if (idx === dots.length - 1 || idx === 0) dir *= -1;
      render();
    }, 480));
  });

  // Dashed connector lines: each ring card -> center of ITEMS stamp.
  // Scoped to the ITEMS box only; only meaningful once the >=960px ring
  // layout is active; recomputed on resize (debounced) and via
  // ResizeObserver so it stays correct across the 760px/960px breakpoints.
  const svg = $('#irw-hero-connectors');
  const inner = $('#irw-hero-items-inner');
  const stampItems = $('#irw-hero-stamp-items');
  const cardIds = ['#irw-hero-card-choice', '#irw-hero-card-likert', '#irw-hero-card-slider'];

  const drawConnectors = () => {
    if (window.innerWidth < 960) { svg.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    const innerRect = inner.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (innerRect.width === 0) return;
    const items = stampItems.getBoundingClientRect();
    const itemsCenter = {
      x: items.left + items.width / 2 - innerRect.left,
      y: items.top + items.height / 2 - innerRect.top
    };
    let html = '';
    cardIds.forEach(id => {
      const r = $(id).getBoundingClientRect();
      const cx = r.left + r.width / 2 - innerRect.left;
      const cy = r.bottom - innerRect.top;
      html += `<line x1="${cx}" y1="${cy}" x2="${itemsCenter.x}" y2="${itemsCenter.y}"
                stroke="#1c1c22" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6 6" stroke-opacity="0.35" />`;
    });
    svg.innerHTML = html;
  };

  requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(drawConnectors));
  let resizeTimer;
  const onResize = () => { clearTimeout(resizeTimer); resizeTimer = setTimeout(drawConnectors, 120); };
  window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);
  const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => drawConnectors());
  resizeObserver.observe(inner);

  invalidation.then(() => {
    intervals.forEach(id => clearInterval(id));
    clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
    window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize);
    resizeObserver.disconnect();
  });

  return root;
}
```
